easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an extra activation of your planeswalkers' abilities this turn.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the mana-producing permanent.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 one additional time with the nontoken Aminatou, and one additional time with the token Aminatou.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 3.
